calls.brief: Frozen decision D1 and finding F1: fava-mark-static.svg is the sole hand-authored geometry and base-colour authority; the GPU scene was illustrative and must derive from that SVG, never become a second author of the mark.

parsed.text: The SVG file fava-mark-static.svg is the single source of truth for the logo's geometry and base colours; the GPU scene must reflect this SVG, not diverge.
parsed.teaches: Maintain a single authoritative source for critical design elements.

calls.brief: Frozen decision D4: intrinsic extrusion depth is minDepth + (maxDepth - minDepth) * sqrt(area / maxArea), with area measured after SVG transforms and curve flattening in normalized viewBox units. Larger faces advance farther by measured law, not by eye.

parsed.text: Intrinsic extrusion depth scales with the square root of the face area, ensuring larger faces extend proportionally further.
parsed.teaches: Larger faces advance farther based on their area, not just visual size.

calls.brief: Frozen decisions D8 and D19: selection uses raw pointer coordinates and depth-aware picking through the exact current projection/view/model transforms; camera smoothing must never change hit identity. Smooth the camera; never smooth the pick.

parsed.text: Smooth the camera, not the pick, to maintain hit identity.
parsed.teaches: Maintaining hit identity is crucial when smoothing the camera in a 3D environment.

calls.brief: Frozen decisions D3 and D25 (dual-N): every supported path gets a deterministic ordinal ID; facet count N is manifest data. The favicon fixture may assert N=13, but shaders, hosts, skills, and stagger loops must iterate dynamic N — never bake the fixture count into engine constants.

parsed.text: Every supported path has a unique ID, and the number of facets is dynamic, not hardcoded.
parsed.teaches: Dynamic facet counts ensure flexibility in engine design.

calls.brief: Frozen decisions D22, D30, D46: animation advances from elapsed time, not frame count; choreography (extrusion, separation, quaternion slerp) is elapsed-time driven so a slow machine meets the same pose at the same second.

parsed.text: Animate by elapsed time, not frame count, to ensure consistent timing across devices.
parsed.teaches: Using elapsed time for animations guarantees that the timing remains consistent regardless of the device's performance.

calls.brief: Frozen decision D54: teach sound synchronicity as the first relevance utility of the Rive + AnimaScript stack — who owns the audible sample clock — before mesh and picking depth. The hearable specimen owns the sample clock; the GPU 3D loop owns elapsed-time choreography; do not invent sample-lock between them.

parsed.text: In the Rive + AnimaScript stack, the audible specimen owns the sample clock, while the GPU 3D loop manages elapsed-time choreography; avoid creating a sample-lock between them.
parsed.teaches: Understand the distinct roles of audio and GPU in managing time and synchronization.

calls.brief: Finding F5 and frozen decision D14: a merge story cannot be authored before a merge exists; public provenance is generated only from real Git/GitHub events. Observed history, never anticipatory narrative.

parsed.text: A merge story reflects real Git events, not anticipatory narratives.
parsed.teaches: Public provenance is derived from actual Git history, not hypothetical scenarios.

calls.brief: Frozen decision D53: animation wisdom leaves as TTOD proposals that cite findings/decisions which stay in the pack. The aphorism teaches the contract; the finding remains the proof. Never retire a cold review because a sentence was proposed.

parsed.text: Propose TTOD aphorisms to capture wisdom, but keep the detailed findings in the contract for reference.
parsed.teaches: Wisdom is distilled into aphorisms, while detailed findings remain in the contract.

calls.brief: Frozen decision D16: the extruder is a reusable SVG-path-to-mesh build tool; the favicon is its golden fixture, not embedded business logic. The fixture proves the tool; it must not become the tool.

parsed.text: The favicon serves as a test case for the SVG-path-to-mesh tool, not as a core feature of the tool itself.
parsed.teaches: Test cases should validate tools without becoming part of the core logic.
